items.fact: Not bugs: oldselector legacy rename (C314); evaulationContext param at JslDslGenerator.java:226 deliberate (b68a1fd4, JNG-5916); TypeInfo modifier asymmetry unreachable (C318); Lombok dep in root pom deliberate (OSGi import excludes !lombok, pom.xml:62); getLowerBound/getUpperBound lacking null check safe; ScriptModelBundleTracker/QueryModelBundleTracker deactivate() does unregister all (BundleTrackerManagerImpl.unregisterBundleCallback in runtime__osgi-utils:160-164) and HashMap/ConcurrentHashMap mix is safe under @Synchronized("lock"); duplicate-unregister bug in C327b is real; QueryModel.jsl max = 100 + 100 deliberate (QueryTest expects count 2 with values 50, 175); pinning poi-ooxml-schemas 4.1.2 and docx4j-ImportXHTML 8.3.11 necessary (no newer releases); EPL-2.0 in AGENTS.md correct (only feature/feature.xml has EPL 1.0 text); empty openapi.evl is placeholder.

items.topic: jetty-metrics handler records counts but not real timings
items.claim: reader: jetty-metrics handler never attached so no metrics
items.fact: Pax Web 8.0.33 picks up any registered Handler service and calls it each request, so request counts/status meters are recorded; timers don't measure real processing as handler runs after others and wraps nothing (checked in pax-web and metrics-jetty9 3.2.6 jars).

items.topic: Generator docs: URI priority, snake case, getVariable
items.claim: docs say first URI wins / camelCaseToSnakeCase lowercase / getVariable returns value or null
items.fact: ChainedURLTemplateLoader.createFromURIs: last URI wins on purpose (ModelGenerator.java:1141 first URI is base, later are overrides); camelCaseToSnakeCase returns upper case (MY_VAR) intentionally, sdk-core templates use it for Java constants; getVariable (api-reference.md:277) throws when no context bound; custom patterns run before whitespace flags deliberately; README recalculateChecksumToDirectory 3-arg signature wrong ((File,String) overload exists at ModelGenerator.java:602); GitIgnoreSynchronizer missing end marker runs block to EOF by design (:105); tab removal deletes tabs per README.md:1049.

items.topic: judo-ng-read pipeline: round.py, batch splitting, re-queue after abort
items.fact: Pipeline in target/judo-ng-read: `NREAD=21 NVER=24 python3 round.py [done readers] -- [done verifiers]` prints progress and NEXT readers/verify; python3 check_batch.py <ID> accepts/rejects a batch; batches with no output are auto-split (C383→C383a/b); readers via judo-ng-reader subagent (model @explore) with reader-prompt.md, validators via judo-ng-validator (@validate) with validator-prompt.md, 6 batches each; validator fails batch if >1 reader-wrong or >25% of checked. Aborted subagents leave status 'running' in queue-state.json — remove them before re-running round.py; check out/<ID>.json and out/<ID>.validate.json to see what finished. A reader that wrote unverified facts (C411) is queued into reread_priority and re-read with 'only write what you checked'. Readers sometimes misread scope ('read src' when batch has only openspec docs) — batch file is authoritative; checker only validates line numbers/symbols exist, not substance.
